objective: Realistic complete solar years with a single reviewed latest version. Preserve V5 exactly. No claim of global optimality.
normalized_target: CF divided by training-only empirical 95th-percentile seasonal hourly envelope smoothed over 31 days at fixed clock hour, floor 0.01. This is not a physical clear-sky irradiance model.
training_support: Train on astronomical solar support only; force zero outside the same support. Quantile objective and quantile early-stopping metric.
dense_family_selection: Smallest average inner CF-unit pinball loss over core quantiles. Extra tail models independently inner-tuned for tree counts then refitted on all training years.
postprocessing_fit: Generated screening paths and training moments only. Annual level samples training annual means. One common validation mean scale, frozen after screening.
incumbent: Previously validated S013; also test frozen 50-percent central blend with V5, retaining S013 weather deviations. No main change unless independently confirmed.
acceptance: Previous generation gates plus ACF1 error <= max(1.5 historical validation error,0.0015), monthly SD ratios 0.85-1.15, fair CRPS <=1.03 historical, unique paths, night zeros, low-event errors <=1.5 historical with count floor5 days and longest floor1 day. Mean MAE/RMSE <=1.02 actual V5 validation values. CRPS/ramp/daily-weekly persistence/interval-calibration must improve or equal V5. Both confirmation seeds and fixed-production sample pass.
critical_defect_waiver: Higher individual member MAE/RMSE, annual mean MAE, and potentially ACF1 error than V5 may be accepted only alongside repaired severe V5 underdispersion, calibrated intervals, temporal realism and bounded mean-profile accuracy. All regressions reported. No assertion of improvement on every metric.
score: Equal-weight mean log ratios to historical for member MAE, fair CRPS, duration W1, ramp W1, ACF24 and ACF168 errors. Select on validation only. Incumbent retained if no sufficiently better accepted candidate; require score improvement >0.001 for replacement.
shortlist: Best three accepted by score plus best accepted member MAE and best dense/normalized family, duplicates removed, maximum six. Include incumbent controls in confirmation.
preservation: No V5 overwrite, manuscript edits, production-energy input activation, energy solves or messages to others. Publish one frozen latest candidate and complete review trail. Joint weather dependence remains outside solar-only work.
